weights_license: MIT declared by official model repository
revision_and_lfs_sha256: must resolve and pin before download
download_artifacts: one required Safetensors plus config/processor/license; no pickle model files or full repository snapshot
feature: get_video_features; frozen weights; no text prompts or generated descriptions
arms: same selected center frame repeated eight times
prototype_head: equal-video positive/negative cosine centroids fitted inside each TRAIN group fold; no deep head or scaler
positive_supervision: nearest fixed-grid window to official TRAIN point; other positive windows unlabeled
negative_supervision: negative-video windows with equal video mass
inference: full fixed window grid, no source name, label or known event point
auto_groups: preserve frozen dataset split; exact-unique TRAIN units with explicit original multiplicity
stop: Freeze final implementation and protocol before real-data features; one run, no post-result threshold/head/feature selection. Stop on failed technical or TRAIN gates. Preserve static/repeated comparator and report all outcomes. No rules/types inferred from binary labels.
